name: Clickio Consent
author: clickio

sections.description:
Clickio Consent helps you to comply with privacy regulations and industry standards such as TCF v2, GPP, Google Consent Mode v2.

  • Google and IAB Certified
  • Built-in Paywall & Paywall Integration
  • Consent Mode v2 Support
  • Easy-to-Use and Customizable
  • Implement in minutes

Features

General

  • Google AdSense / Ad Manager integration
  • Customizable design
  • A/B Testing
  • Local language support
  • Multi-language support
  • Custom disclosures
  • AMP support
  • Long-term consent string storage

Vendor Management

  • Custom TCF and Google ATP vendor lists
  • Custom non-TCF vendors
  • Optimized vendor list
  • Geo-specific vendor lists
  • Google Consent Mode v2

Reporting & Analytics

  • Daily event reporting
  • Monthly Unique User reporting
  • Reporting API

Other features

  • Paywall integration (Consent or Subscribe mode)
  • Built-in Cookie Paywall
  • Support and implementation services

Technical Implementation and External Services

Clickio Consent leverages the official CMP API v2 code maintained by IAB Tech Lab to ensure compliance with GDPR requirements in digital advertising. The CMP API v2 acts as an interface for Consent Management Platforms (CMPs), allowing web and in-app callers to access transparency and consent data. This framework includes components like the Global Vendor List (GVL), the Transparency and Consent String (TC String) for storing consent data, APIs for processing the TC String, and policies governing TCF use—facilitating publishers’ adherence to GDPR standards.

The plugin loads necessary Clickio CMP JavaScript code from clickiocmp.com, a domain owned by Clickio. This code displays the appropriate consent dialog based on user location and site settings, collects privacy choices from visitors, and communicates these choices to integrated vendors.

Clickio Consent relies on industry-standard frameworks to relay user consent information:

  • IAB Transparency and Consent Framework – Learn more
  • IAB Global Privacy Platform – Learn more
  • Google Consent Mode – Learn more

User choices are stored for up to 390 days in cookies and local storage variables: __lxG__consent__v2, __lxG__consent__v2_daisybit, __lxG__consent__v2_gdaisybit. The plugin operates under Clickio’s Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.

short_description: The fastest way to activate Clickio Consent in Wordpress. Comply with GDPR, TCF and Consent Mode in minutes.
